name: Steel Edgebelly
description: Cut forward from the formal opening bow of the school with the edge leading.

name: Trimverdict
description: Jab the point along a thin straight thread into the opening of the guard.

name: Statute Tangpin
description: Draw the sleeve and blade across the body like a mantle to cover a cut.

name: Inferno Scales
description: Slice from a settled seat in the stance with qi threaded through the edge.

name: Unbending Shave
description: Lead with the free hand in a formal gesture and cut from the other side.

name: Pareodyssey
description: Step to the side in the school's even pace and turn the blade to the new line.

name: Triumphant Pare
description: Cut with a qi-weighted edge that answers an opponent's first move with a decisive reply.

name: Pealswedge
description: Parry in two linked motions that turn the blow and set up the return cut.

name: Quenched Slit
description: Bring the field-backed edge down in a single formal stroke that closes the exchange.

name: Peel Verdict
description: A school move that gathers the whole stance into one formal edge sized to the user's reserve.

name: Squall Plunge
description: Draw the edge across the target in a low curved arc like water into a basin.

name: Peeledict
description: Stab the point through a gap like a stem through a line of reeds.

name: Statute Lanyard
description: Hold a low broad guard that catches and spreads the force of a strike.

name: Squall Swedge
description: Slice along the upper line of the guard like water over a basin's lip.

name: Pallpeel
description: Cloud the opponent's read with slow shifting cuts that hide the true stroke.

name: Spectral Thumbramp
description: Pour forward off a high stance in a quick downhill step and cut.

name: Sigil Buttcap
description: Hook the opponent's weapon into the hollow of the guard and hold it.

name: Thunderclap Bolster
description: Rake the edge in a rushing torrent of cuts down the whole guard.

name: Prismswedge
description: Anchor the stance and hold a heavy qi-backed guard through repeated strikes.

name: Inferno Whittle
description: Pour field qi along the edge in a deluge that drowns the guard in a single cut.

name: Peerless Haemal Choil
description: A school move that meets two cuts of qi and body in the basin and floods the floor.

name: Steelchoil
description: Fix the gaze on a single mark and cut straight at it from the guard.

name: Radiance Whittle
description: Thrust the point level with the eyes at the opponent's chosen mark.

name: Bedrock Scales
description: Raise the blade to cover the eyes and face against a high strike.

name: Pare Solace
description: Step along the line of sight and never let the mark leave the center.

name: Fearless Choil
description: Slice with a gaze locked on one spot of the opponent's wrist or neck.

name: Venom Bolster
description: Tap the marked wrist with the spine to break the stroke it was about to make.

name: Gracious Buttcap
description: Read every shift of the opponent's shoulders and hips by a steady far gaze.

name: Trimpledge
description: Lock the opponent's weapon against the blade as the eyes stay on its holder.

name: Pulsar Trim
description: Dive on the marked point and pierce through the guard with a qi-loaded tip.

name: Pall Edgebelly
description: Hold a hovering watch with the blade that turns away every strike aimed at the body.

name: Steel Slit
description: Cut the exact mark chosen at the start of the stroke with field-backed force.

name: Peerless Bedrock Trim
description: A school move that falls on the marked point from above with no sound before the cut.

name: Illustrious Peel
description: Draw the edge across the target in a line that joins the opponent's own motion.

name: Prism Lanyard
description: Jab in a short side line that feeds into the main stroke.

name: Crushing Tangpin
description: Hold the blade like a river bank that turns a strike into a different course.

name: Magnificent Swedge
description: Cut two lines that meet on one point of the opponent's guard.

name: Peal Thumbramp
description: Draw a strike into a slow backwater turn and send it past the shoulder.

name: Deluge Whittle
description: Move along a narrow channel of footing and cut at its end.

name: Steelplunge
description: Press two strokes together into a single heavy cut on the opponent's guard.

name: Searing Trim
description: Hold the opponent's weapon in a joined current of qi and blade for a long breath.

name: Illustrious Edgebelly
description: Rejoin a split stroke into one great cut with the whole field behind it.

name: Vaunted Bedrock Plunge
description: A school move that unites many streams of cuts into one edge of single force.

name: Haemalpeel
description: Open on the body track with a cut while the field readies its own track.

name: Illustrious Lanyard
description: Jab the point on the qi track so it lands slightly ahead of the arm.

name: Rending Plunge
description: Cover the body with the flat while the field takes the force of the blow.

name: Feather Tangpin
description: Walk in steps that alternate body and field to hide the pace of the advance.

name: Steel Thumbramp
description: Slice once with the body and once with the field in the same stroke.

name: Deluge Bolster
description: Switch tracks in the middle of a parry to defeat a feint.

name: Nurturing Buttcap
description: Let the field follow every moving blade and feed its position back to the user.

name: Commanding Shave
description: Bind the opponent's weapon on one track and cut on the other.

name: Thunderclap Scales
description: Cut with qi and body on two rails that arrive at the target together.

name: Tangpin Reliquary
description: Take a strike on one rail and send its force back along the other.

name: Skyborne Swedge
description: Flash along both rails across the field and cut at the end of the flash.

name: Vacuum Slit
description: A school move in which the qi rail and body rail meet in the point of the knife.

name: Peelbanner
description: Draw the knife with the settled calm of a Core and cut across the target.

name: Pulsar Peel
description: Jab the point in a talon-like curl with qi drawn from the Core.

name: Bolster Reliquary
description: Spread the free arm like a wing and cover the blade side behind a steady guard.

name: Vigor Shave
description: Slice at the end of a short stoop with qi released from the Core.

name: Pealplunge
description: Parry with a blade steadied by Core qi so that heavy blows slide off.

name: Thrall Pare
description: Hold the opponent's weapon in a hovering lock of qi and blade.

name: Vigor Scales
description: Take wide light steps with qi in the legs like a hawk's easy glide.

name: Triumphant Whittle
description: Rake the blade in a hawk's talon strokes with Core qi in each pass.

name: Swedgeseal
description: Hold a guard in which an updraft of Core qi lifts and turns every strike.

name: Squall Lanyard
description: Dive onto the target and cut with the full force of a Core behind the edge.

name: Lordly Steel Peel
description: A school move in which the full reserve falls through the knife in one descent.

name: Squallslit
description: Draw the knife on the sworn wind and cut in the school's standing line.

name: Steelshave
description: Jab the point on a sworn gust into the first gap the guard shows.

name: Bedrock Thumbramp
description: Cover the body with the flat as a gust passes over and around it.

name: Inferno Shave
description: Slice along the line of a gust with qi threaded into the edge.

name: Bedrock Slit
description: Meet an attack from a rooted stance and cut back along the same line.

name: Despotic Plunge
description: Bind the opponent's weapon with a gust of qi pressing the blade down.

name: Deluge Choil
description: Step forward on a gust and land with the edge already cutting.

name: Vigorswedge
description: Rake the edge through the guard in strokes that carry the gale's weight.

name: Stately Buttcap
description: Parry a heavy blow with a sworn gale that sweeps the strike off line.

name: Choil Banner
description: Release a tempest of field qi along the edge in one sworn stroke.

name: Vigor Trim
description: A school move in which the sworn wind and the edge are made one cut.

name: Squallchoil
description: Cut along the opening bearing the school fixes before the stroke begins.

name: Famed Swedge
description: Jab at a mark sighted along the held bearing and return to guard.

name: Titan Buttcap
description: Cover along the held bearing with the blade and forearm together.

name: Edgebelly Verdict
description: Slice along a long course across the plateau without any change of line.

name: Scales Troth
description: Parry and return at once to the held course with the blade.

name: Shavevoyage
description: Shift the pace and the bearing together to flank the opponent.

name: Sovereign Shave
description: Sweep the edge along the whole front on a held bearing to keep foes back.

name: Masterful Thumbramp
description: Press the opponent's blade down along the bearing in a long steady push.

name: Pulsarpare
description: Flash along the held bearing in one rush and cut as the field arrives.

name: Unrivaled Whittle
description: A school move in which a single bearing is held through the cut to the plateau's edge.

name: Shavedecree
description: Draw the knife with the oath spoken in the mind and cut along its line.

name: Steelscales
description: Jab along a line the oath has set and never turn the point aside.

name: Fierce Choil
description: Cover the body with the edge as the oath demands no step back.

name: Bedrock Swedge
description: Step along the sworn line and hold the stance at the end of each pace.

name: Steel Pare
description: Cross two oath lines in an X-shaped slice through the guard.

name: Steel Lanyard
description: Hold the sworn line against the attack and return the cut along it.

name: Sigilshave
description: Bind the opponent's weapon along the sworn line and pin it there.

name: Hospitable Bolster
description: Feel along the sworn line for every body and blade that crosses it.

name: Slitedict
description: Rend the guard open with an edge backed by a gale of sworn qi.

name: Squall Tangpin
description: Parry from a standing oath so heavily rooted that blows slide off.

name: Haemal Edgebelly
description: Judge the whole exchange in one field-backed cut along the sworn line.

name: Thunderclap Pare
description: A school move in which a sworn line parts the wind and the guard together.

name: Fearless Trim
description: Draw the knife and cut as though the gale were tied to the edge.

name: Quenched Peel
description: Jab the point on a bound gust that guides it into a gap.

name: Squall Bolster
description: Turn the blade as a bound gust turns and send a blow past the body.

name: Peeltriumph
description: Slice along the bound wind's push with qi threaded through the edge.

name: Deluge Thumbramp
description: Parry with a bound wind of qi that catches the blow and bends it aside.

name: Thrall Slit
description: Bind the opponent's weapon in a loop of gale qi around the blade.

name: Squallscales
description: Step on a bound gust and arrive at the opponent's side.

name: Vigorslit
description: Surge qi into the edge and cut with a gale straining against the blade.

name: Scales Seal
description: Hold a standing guard in which a bound gale circles the body and blade.

name: Illustrious Shave
description: Burst the bound gale along the edge in a single field-backed cut.

name: Tyrannous Pare
description: A school move that binds the gale to the edge and releases it through the cut.

name: Splendid Choil
description: Draw the knife under the open sky and cut along the line sworn to it.

name: Prism Tangpin
description: Jab the point on the sky's oath into the nearest gap of the guard.

name: Plungeseal
description: Cover the body with the blade and field in an open-ground guard.

name: Squall Buttcap
description: Slice with the full sweep of the open sky behind the edge.

name: Shavebanner
description: Answer a strike on open ground with a counter cut along the same line.

name: Squall Trim
description: Cross wide open ground in a few long field-aided steps.

name: Quenched Plunge
description: Cut with a gale of qi drawn from the open sky into the edge.

name: Steelswedge
description: Hold a standing guard in which the open sky itself seems to turn blows away.

name: Evanescent Swedge
description: Flash across open ground in the instant of the cut and land behind the guard.

name: Exalted Plunge Verdict
description: A school move whose single cut is sworn in the open with no wall behind it.

name: Haemalplunge
description: Draw the knife in the settled calm of a Core and cut along the held line.

name: Vacuum Lanyard
description: Jab the point with Core qi so steadily that wind cannot turn it.

name: Statute Thumbramp
description: Hold the blade across the line of attack as a still guard in a gale.

name: Squallshave
description: Step on a held line with Core qi settling through the legs.

name: Vigorchoil
description: Slice with a held wind of Core qi that lengthens each stroke.

name: Royal Bolster
description: Wait out an attack and counter in the lull between two gusts.

name: Thrallswedge
description: Bind the opponent's weapon with a held wind and keep it still.

name: Interstice Edgebelly
description: Read the whole field through the held wind that touches the blade.

name: Steel Trim
description: Rake the edge through the guard with Core qi streaming along the blade.

name: Parity Plunge
description: Parry with the whole wind of Core qi flowing around the edge.

name: Haemal Slit
description: Bring the held wind down through the edge in one cut of a Core's reserve.

name: Noble Peel
description: A school move that holds the whole wind inside the blade and releases it in one cut.
